["Text of Rule 38 (Exemptions) of the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea, 1972 (the Convention annex, printed with 33 U.S.C. 1602 note and 33 CFR part 81 materials) is not held. Section 3 of the order authorizes exemptions under Rule 38 for vessels whose keel was laid before July 15, 1977, and Rule 38 sets time-limited and permanent exemption categories, so whether that authority had lapsed by 2026-10-14 cannot be decided from held sources. The prepared inventory also merges Sections 2 and 3 into the Section 1(c) clause and would need correction."]

No held source decides whether the Consumer Affairs Council, the one-time reports (Sections 1-501 to 1-503) and the program-reform tasks continued to 2026-10-14. Missing: official EO 13286 evidence, a corrected inventory, and a source on the Council's status after Executive Order 12265."]

["Statute text not held: 5 U.S.C. 3161(a)(1) (maximum period and any extension of a temporary organization), which fixes when the Afghanistan and Pakistan Strategic Partnership Office terminated under Section 5, and 5 U.S.C. 3161 generally; no source shows an extension or an earlier termination by the Secretary of State.
